statement.zh: 阿玛尔纳 EES 1921–1922 年南城、Maru-Aten 与工匠村工作见 Peet & Woolley《阿肯那顿之城》I（1923）。
statement.en: At Amarna, EES 1921–1922 work on the South City, Maru-Aten, and the Workmen’s Village is documented in Peet & Woolley City of Akhenaten I (1923).
